description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper for a WebView, managing its lifecycle, navigation, and communication with JavaScript via message handlers. It includes a coordinator class for handling WebView setup, updates, teardown, navigation delegate for deep link interception, and message handler for JS-to-native communication.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinator class responsible for managing the WKWebView's lifecycle, navigation, and message handling.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: Handles navigation actions in WKWebView, mainly intercepting custom URL schemes for deep linking.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: Handles messages from JavaScript to trigger native actions based on message content.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates and configures the container view and WebView, adds the WebView as a subview with constraints, and attaches the WebView to the controller.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and reattaches/detaches the WebView if the controller instance changes.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up references, removes handlers, and detaches the WebView from the controller.

methods.name: makeWebView
methods.description: Configures and instantiates a WKWebView with custom settings and content inset adjustments.

methods.name: installA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Adds JavaScript message handlers to the WKUserContentController.

methods.name: removeA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Removes JavaScript message handlers from the WKUserContentController.
